name: Briar
notes: Opens with Certain Death (R) when learned: its 1 s kick plus 1.25 s dash-cast (taken as sequential cast-time delays with no separate travel time, since the dummy is stationary and effectively adjacent) land the magic explosion and start Hematomania, granting Blood Frenzy's attack-speed buff.
Head Rush (Q) is cast on cooldown for its own damage, shred and attack reset, throughout the fight.

Blood Frenzy (W) is cast/recast on cooldown to arm Snack Attack (its bonus damage rides the very next basic attack and resets the attack timer, as does Head Rush) and, once Hematomania has ended, to reapply the attack-speed/frenzy window for another 5 s.

Chilling Scream (E) is cast on cooldown throughout the fight, charged for its full 1 s for maximum damage (the terrain-collision bonus damage is skipped since the fight has no terrain): per the wiki this interrupts an active frenzy/Hematomania, ending its attack-speed buff and (permanently, since R's long cooldown never comes back up in this fight) the Hematomania mark, but Blood Frenzy is recast right after to regain the attack-speed window, and E's own damage plus its own bleed application still outweigh the lost uptime. This keeps E as a genuine damage source in every fight length, as the numbers require.

Blood Frenzy's area-of-effect cleave damage around the attack target needs another nearby unit to hit and is never dealt in this single-dummy fight, per the general fight rules; only the frenzy's attack-speed uptime and Snack Attack matter here.

The passive bleed applies once per basic attack (including a Snack-Attack-empowered one, counted as a single on-hit application) and once per damaging ability cast (Q, E, R); it ticks every 0.5 s for 5 s, refreshing to a full 10 ticks and adding a stack (capped at 5) on each new application, with each stack beyond the first adding 25% tick damage.
Head Rush's armor/magic resistance shred is fixed in this kit at its max-rank value (20%) since the engine reads a single static shred percent for it; Head Rush is assumed maxed by level 16 as usual.

All costs (5% of Briar's current health per cast) are ignored: since the cost is a percentage of remaining health it can never reduce her to zero, so it never gates casts within an 8-15 s fight. Healing and self-sustain (Crimson Curse's heal, Snack Attack's heal, Chilling Scream's heal) are ignored entirely since healing does not matter in this fight per the rules.

Crowd control (stun, fear, knockback, slow) and mobility (dash, ghosting, bonus move speed, damage reduction while charging) are ignored; the dummy never reacts to them and mitigation from Chilling Scream's damage reduction does not matter here.

assumed.why: Certain Death's damage timing sums the dossier's two stated cast-time components (1 s kick, 1.25 s dash-prep) with no separate travel/dash time added, since the dummy is stationary and effectively adjacent.
the engine reads a single static shred percent for Head Rush; using its max-rank value (20%) since Q is assumed maxed by level 16.
